svg.title: V. The arsenal
svg.desc: The arsenal. Every day: C#, .NET, Angular, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Docker, Git, GitHub Actions. Practised: JavaScript, PHP, Python, Java, Rust, SQL; HTML, CSS, Sass, Tailwind CSS, RxJS, GSAP, React; ASP.NET Core, SignalR, Node.js, Symfony, Spring Boot, Axum, Tokio; EF Core, MySQL, SQLite, Doctrine, SQLx; Ionic, Capacitor; Claude and Codex agents, MCP servers, speech synthesis; xUnit, Vitest, PHPUnit, Playwright, axe-core; Linux, Nginx, Caddy, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus.

text.tspan: What I use every day, then what my projects put to work.
